name: Amanda Wood Laihow
current_role: Deputy Assistant Secretary of Labor for Occupational Safety and Health (since February 2025)
summary: Amanda Wood Laihow is OSHA’s political deputy assistant secretary. She ran the agency as acting assistant secretary from March to October 2025, until David Keeling took office, and was still speaking for it as deputy in February 2026.
